opening_balance.title: Opening Balance
opening_balance.subtitle: Enter opening balance per account as the starting point of balance calculation.
opening_balance.form_hint: The opening balance is written as the starting checkpoint of the account balance. The sign follows the account's normal position.
opening_balance.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this opening balance?

period_closing.title: Period Closing
period_closing.subtitle: Close accounting period (monthly/yearly). A closed period is locked from journal changes.
period_closing.close_hint: Locks the period from journal changes and records closing history. Can be reopened.
period_closing.closing_on_desc: The system creates a closing entry that zeroes revenue & expense accounts for the period and moves net profit/loss to Retained Earnings. Impact: the Profit & Loss report for that period becomes zero after closing (profit moved to equity). Follows formal closing practice. Requires COA_RETAINED_EARNINGS configuration.
period_closing.closing_off_desc: Only locks the period and records history. Current-year profit is still computed automatically on the Balance Sheet without a closing entry. Recommended for monthly closing.
period_closing.reopen_hint: The period will be reopened; the closing entry (if any) will be voided.

form.normal_position_hint: Determines balance sign: Credit = (credit - debit), Debit = (debit - credit).

mark_as_paid.description: This PO will be marked as paid and drops off the outstanding list and downloads. Every invoice carrying this PO number also becomes Paid in Invoice Exchange, AP List, and Payment.
mark_as_paid.no_journal_warning: No journal is posted, so the Supplier Payable balance in the ledger does not change. Use this only for payments already recorded from another source. It can be undone via the "Marked as Paid" filter.

unmark_as_paid.title: Undo Mark as Paid
unmark_as_paid.description: This PO returns to the outstanding list, and every invoice settled through Mark as Paid goes back to Unpaid. Invoices paid through the Payment menu are left untouched.
